rss: US prices remain high as fuel costs squeeze household budgets
title: Prices Rise, Squeeze Kid Coin
story: Prices are going up because fuel costs more. Families have less money for fun stuff.
storyBig: Inflation is causing prices to rise by 3.4% over the past year, driven by increased fuel costs. This economic pressure is reducing discretionary spending for households.
think: Why might higher prices affect how much ice cream you can buy?
bull: If prices go up, some families might find new ways to save money.
bear: With higher prices, it might be harder for families to afford fun things.

rss: Primark finally set to launch home deliveries
title: Big Store Now Delivers Fun Stuff
story: Big Store will start bringing toys to your house! Now you can shop from home.
storyBig: The retailer's launch of home delivery represents its entry into e-commerce after years focusing on in-store sales. This move could significantly increase their market reach.
think: Why is it fun to get something delivered to your door?
bull: Home delivery makes shopping easy and fun!
bear: Sometimes deliveries can take longer than going to the store.
